concrete_scene.heading: Worked benchmark collision: same score, opposite decision
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: Two model candidates with equal aggregate pass counts, one clean lineage, one contaminated selection process, and a benchmark instrument lease
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Use the same pass count to promote both candidates.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The clean candidate can update a narrow claim while the contaminated candidate remains quarantined because lineage and contamination differ.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether aggregate score determines evidentiary admissibility; it does not.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Construct, dataset, harness, contamination, retry, baseline, regression, uncertainty, transfer, and decision owners retain separate residuals.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The finite collision proves count insufficiency for the model, not construct validity, benchmark quality, contamination detection, capability, or anti-Goodhart efficacy.

worked_trace.heading: Worked benchmark collision: same score, opposite decision
worked_trace.maximum_inference: Aggregate count cannot classify the modeled evidence state; real construct validity, contamination detection, hidden-holdout integrity, capability, and robustness remain unproven.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The leaderboard baseline ranks equal scores equally. The instrument lease distinguishes clean, contaminated, saturated, and selected histories.
readable_claim: Two benchmark runs can have the same pass count and opposite evidentiary value when one is clean and the other is contaminated, selected, or saturated.
normative_rule: Bind each score to construct, dataset, harness, checkpoint, output, evaluator, baseline, retry lineage, contamination state, regression floors, uncertainty, cost, and claim axis. Quarantine persists until the causal problem is repaired; aggregate score cannot wash it away.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The scene states once that a formal collision does not validate the benchmark.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Constructs, capacity, contamination, holdouts, baselines, regressions, transfer, capability, safety, and SOTA remain distinct.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The equal-count collision remains reader-facing; full lease fields and mutations stay in formal evidence.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The short claim surfaces the anti-aggregation argument.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The benchmark-validity boundary follows the example once.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: Benchmark state tables remain because clean, saturated, and contaminated outcomes differ.

non_claims: The collision does not establish benchmark construct validity.
